boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces for studying, collaborating, making, or taking a break between classes.

cards.title: Whole Music Club
cards.subtitle: Coffman Memorial Union basement, East Bank
cards.notes: Check whether the room is hosting a concert; when it is not, use its tables and couches for an individual session or to spread out with classmates.
cards.short_summary: A concert venue that also opens as a public study space when not in use for performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Unions & Activities identifies the Whole Music Club as a Coffman basement study space with tables and couches when it is not being used for concerts.
cards.source_title: Coffman Memorial Union | Student Unions and Activities
cards.access_notes: Inside Coffman Memorial Union; public study use is available when the venue is not in use for concerts. Check current building hours.

cards.title: Goldy's Gameroom
cards.subtitle: Coffman Memorial Union basement, East Bank
cards.notes: Bring work that suits a livelier room: the space has music, food, tables, and chairs, so it works for a change of pace from a quiet floor.
cards.short_summary: A basement union room with study tables in a more animated setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Unions & Activities states that Goldy's Gameroom offers music, food, tables, and chairs for studying.
cards.source_title: Coffman Memorial Union | Student Unions and Activities
cards.access_notes: Located in the Coffman basement. Check current Coffman building hours before going.

cards.title: The Cube
cards.subtitle: Coffman Memorial Union ground floor, East Bank
cards.notes: Set up at a table or couch near the west end of the ground floor, beside Starbucks and the University of Minnesota Bookstore.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor Coffman seating area with tables and couches.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Unions & Activities describes The Cube as a west-end Coffman ground-floor space with tables and couches for studying.
cards.source_title: Coffman Memorial Union | Student Unions and Activities
cards.access_notes: Located on Coffman's ground floor; this shared/public space cannot be reserved. Check current building hours.

cards.title: East Fireplace Lounge
cards.subtitle: Coffman Memorial Union first floor, East Bank
cards.notes: Use the first-floor lounge for a seated work session, and bring a charger: Student Unions & Activities notes plentiful places to plug in and recharge.
cards.short_summary: One of Coffman's first-floor fireplace lounges with seating and power access.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Unions & Activities lists the East Fireplace Lounge as a first-floor study space with comfortable chairs and places to plug in.
cards.source_title: Coffman Memorial Union | Student Unions and Activities
cards.access_notes: On Coffman's first floor; fireplace lounges are shared/public spaces and cannot be reserved. Check current building hours.

cards.title: West Fireplace Lounge
cards.subtitle: Coffman Memorial Union first floor, East Bank
cards.notes: Meet a classmate or settle into a chair in this first-floor lounge; nearby vending machines offer a practical break without leaving the building.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Coffman lounge with seating, power access, and nearby vending.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Unions & Activities identifies the West Fireplace Lounge as a first-floor study lounge with comfortable chairs, power access, and nearby vending machines.
cards.source_title: Coffman Memorial Union | Student Unions and Activities
cards.access_notes: On Coffman's first floor; fireplace lounges are shared/public spaces and cannot be reserved. Check current building hours.

cards.title: Fountain Terrace
cards.subtitle: Coffman Memorial Union south end, East Bank
cards.notes: On warmer days, take your reading or low-key group work outside to the terrace tables and benches around the Pietro Tacca fountain.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Coffman terrace with tables, benches, and the Pietro Tacca fountain.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Unions & Activities describes Fountain Terrace as an outdoor study space during warmer months, with tables and benches around the Pietro Tacca fountain.
cards.source_title: Coffman Memorial Union | Student Unions and Activities
cards.access_notes: At the south end of Coffman; outdoor study use is seasonal and weather-dependent.

cards.title: Mississippi Lounge
cards.subtitle: Coffman Memorial Union third floor, East Bank
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for river-facing seating; confirm that no private event has reserved the adjoining Mississippi Room before relying on it.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor Coffman lounge with views of the Mississippi River and Fountain Terrace.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Unions & Activities says the Mississippi Lounge has views of the Mississippi River and Fountain Terrace and is open to students when not reserved for a private event.
cards.source_title: Coffman Memorial Union | Student Unions and Activities
cards.access_notes: Third floor of Coffman. Open to students when not reserved for a private event; check current building hours.

cards.title: The Toaster Innovation Hub
cards.subtitle: Walter Library basement, East Bank
cards.notes: Use the open study area for project planning, or reserve a meeting, workshop, or event space through the Libraries' Toaster process.
cards.short_summary: A Walter Library collaboration hub with open study and reservable spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Minnesota Libraries states that The Toaster in Walter Library is free for UMN students and includes open study plus reservable meeting, workshop, and event spaces.
cards.access_notes: In Walter Library's basement. UMN library access requires a U Card; some public access is available by appointment.

cards.title: Walter Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Walter Library, East Bank
cards.notes: Drop in to make a prototype or try equipment such as a 3D printer, sewing machine, button makers, or VR headsets; all skill levels are welcome.
cards.short_summary: A student-run, hands-on making space inside Walter Library.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Minnesota Libraries describes Walter Library's Makerspace as a free-to-use, student-run space with hands-on tools and materials for all majors, years, and skill levels.
cards.source_title: Walter Library | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: Inside Walter Library. A U Card is required for library access; some public access is available by appointment.

cards.title: Northrop Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Northrop floors 1–3, East Bank
cards.notes: Choose an east- or west-side lounge on floors one through three for a first-come study session, then connect a laptop to the monitor for collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: Six first-come student lounges in Northrop with tables, seating, power, and HDMI-enabled monitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Northrop states that its six student study lounges are first-come, first-served and offer natural light, tables, seating, power, Wi-Fi, and monitors for collaborative presentations.
cards.access_notes: Located at the southeast and southwest corners of Northrop floors one through three; first-come, first-served.
